note: Select Text Value ships four FieldWidget plugins (select_string_textfield for string, select_string_textarea for string_long, select_text_textfield for text, select_text_textarea for text_long), all labelled 'Select text value'. It has no configure route, no permissions, no Drush, no services. Config lives entirely in the field's entity_form_display component: content.<field>.type is a select_* id and content.<field>.settings has select_type (select|radios|checkboxes), allowed_values (one per line), custom_value_label (default Other; empty = list only), custom_value_field_title, custom_value_field_description. checkboxes is only offered when field cardinality != 1 and flips handlesMultipleValues() to TRUE. Values are stored in the field's normal storage format. Medium cases read back a configured widget on Article; hard cases switch a plain widget to a Select Text Value widget, verified against the live form display.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module select_text_value, which field widget do I pick to turn a plain single-line text field (a 'string' field) into a predefined list of choices, and what other text field types does the module provide widgets for?
evals.expected_output: Pick the 'Select text value' widget with id select_string_textfield for a string field. The module also provides select_string_textarea (string_long), select_text_textfield (formatted text), and select_text_textarea (text_long).

evals.prompt: The select_text_value widget has a 'Select type' setting. What are the possible values, and is 'Checkboxes' always available?
evals.expected_output: select_type can be 'select' (dropdown), 'radios' (radio buttons), or 'checkboxes'. Checkboxes is only offered when the field cardinality is not 1 (multi-value/unlimited fields); for single-value fields only select and radios are available.

evals.prompt: With the select_text_value widget, how do I let an editor type a value that is not in my predefined list, and how do I instead restrict them to the list only?
evals.expected_output: Set the 'Custom value label' (custom_value_label, default 'Other') to add an extra option that reveals the original text input for free entry. To restrict editors to the allowed list only, leave custom_value_label empty.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a field field_stv_known configured with a Select Text Value widget on its default form display. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which 'Select type' (select, radios, or checkboxes) is configured for that widget.
evals.expected_output: field_stv_known uses the select_string_textfield widget with settings.select_type = radios (radio buttons), per core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two string fields using Select Text Value widgets: field_stv_open and field_stv_locked. Exactly one of them lets an editor enter a custom value outside the predefined list. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which field allows a custom value.
evals.expected_output: field_stv_open allows a custom value: its widget settings.custom_value_label is 'Other', so a custom option appears, whereas field_stv_locked has custom_value_label empty (restricted to the allowed list).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a single-value string field field_stv_task that currently uses the plain text-field widget. Using the select_text_value module, change its default form-display widget to the Select Text Value widget rendered as a dropdown (Select type) with the allowed values Red, Green and Blue. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_stv_task component has type=select_string_textfield with settings.select_type=select and settings.allowed_values listing Red, Green and Blue (one per line).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an unlimited-cardinality string field field_stv_multi that currently uses the plain text-field widget. Using the select_text_value module, change its default form-display widget to the Select Text Value widget rendered as Checkboxes, with a list of allowed values (for example Pool, Gym, Parking). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_stv_multi component has type=select_string_textfield with settings.select_type=checkboxes and a non-empty settings.allowed_values. Checkboxes is available because the field cardinality is not 1.
